tasks.name: Put on a load of laundry
tasks.desc: Gather the clothes that need washing, load the machine, add what it needs, and start the cycle.

tasks.name: Hang the laundry
tasks.desc: Take the finished load out of the washing machine and hang the clothes to dry.

tasks.name: Collect, fold, and put away the laundry
tasks.desc: Collect the dry clothes, fold them, and put them away in their usual places.

tasks.name: Plan meals for the next 2–3 days
tasks.desc: Choose meals for the next two or three days using saved recipes and any new recipes you want to try.

tasks.name: Buy food
tasks.desc: Buy the food needed for the meals you have chosen and any basic items that are running low.

tasks.name: Buy non-food household supplies
tasks.desc: Check what non-food household supplies are missing and buy the items needed to keep the home running.

tasks.name: Cook and prepare containers
tasks.desc: Cook the planned food and leave portions ready to eat or store in containers for later.

tasks.name: Change the sheets and pillowcases
tasks.desc: Remove the used sheets and pillowcases, put on clean ones, and leave the bed ready to use.

tasks.name: Review and reset the wardrobe
tasks.desc: Review the wardrobe, return clothes to their places, and identify anything that no longer belongs there.

tasks.name: Clean and review the fridge
tasks.desc: Check the fridge, remove anything no longer usable, clean the areas that need it, and restore a workable order.

tasks.name: Check the first-aid kit and expiry dates
tasks.desc: Check medicines and medical supplies, review expiry dates, and note anything that needs replacing.

tasks.name: Gentle strength practice
tasks.desc: Choose one or two comfortable strength exercises and practise for 5–10 minutes. Use bodyweight, a wall, a chair, weights, or other equipment as comfortable. Stop before pain or sensory overload.

tasks.name: Low-impact cardio at home
tasks.desc: Move gently at home for a short session using an option that feels tolerable: walking indoors, music, seated movement, or another low-impact routine. Pauses count.

tasks.name: Outdoor movement
tasks.desc: Go outside for a short walk or another comfortable form of movement. There is no distance target, and walking is the normal starting option; running is optional.

tasks.name: Joint mobility
tasks.desc: Move one or more stiff areas gently, such as the neck, shoulders, back, hips, or ankles. Keep the range comfortable and stop if movement hurts.

tasks.name: Gentle stretching or yoga
tasks.desc: Complete a calm, whole-body stretching or gentle yoga session in a position that feels comfortable: standing, seated, supported, or on the floor.

tasks.name: Active recovery
tasks.desc: Choose a very gentle recovery action: a short walk, easy joint movement, a posture change, or a brief wind-down. This is for days when a normal workout would be too much.

tasks.name: Personal care routine
tasks.desc: Choose the body-care need that deserves attention today: skin, hair, nails, hygiene, or another concrete need.

tasks.name: Review the week's expenses
tasks.desc: Review recent transactions and identify one expense or money question that needs action.

tasks.name: Clear your inbox
tasks.desc: Process pending email, archive or delete what no longer matters, and identify messages that need a response.

tasks.name: Plan the week
tasks.desc: Look at the calendar, choose realistic priorities, identify important commitments, and prepare the next concrete steps.

tasks.name: Review finances and budget
tasks.desc: Review income, expenses, and the current budget, then make any adjustment that is actually needed.

tasks.name: Back up data
tasks.desc: Back up important photos, documents, and other data using the storage method you currently rely on.

tasks.name: Review upcoming renewals
tasks.desc: Check subscriptions, documents, and payments that may expire or renew soon, and record any action before the deadline.

tasks.name: Organize a digital folder
tasks.desc: Choose one digital folder, remove or relocate obvious clutter, and leave its structure clear enough to use again.

tasks.name: File your tax return
tasks.desc: Complete and submit the annual income-tax return using the information and documents required for your situation.

tasks.name: Special date with your partner
tasks.desc: Spend intentional quality time with your partner, using a plan that fits the energy and time available.

tasks.name: Contact best friend 1
tasks.desc: Start or maintain contact with this friend by message, call, meeting, or another form that is realistic today.

tasks.name: Contact best friend 2
tasks.desc: Start or maintain contact with this friend by message, call, meeting, or another form that is realistic today.

tasks.name: Call family
tasks.desc: Call or otherwise contact a close family member and give the conversation enough attention to feel real.

tasks.name: Plans with friends
tasks.desc: Propose, organize, or attend a concrete plan with friends. A specific message or date proposal is a valid starting step.

tasks.name: TTRPG session
tasks.desc: Work on the TTRPG project for a focused block. Choose one concrete piece and stop with a clear next step ready.

tasks.name: Chinese practice
tasks.desc: Practise Chinese with an app, video, flashcards, reading, listening, or conversation for a manageable focused block.

tasks.name: Digital detox
tasks.desc: Spend a deliberate period away from screens and choose a low-pressure way to rest or be present.

tasks.name: Gaming session
tasks.desc: Take intentional leisure time to play something you enjoy, without treating rest as a failure to be productive.

tasks.name: Watch a film or series
tasks.desc: Take intentional leisure time to watch something you choose and let the activity be enough.

tasks.name: Read manga
tasks.desc: Take intentional leisure time to read manga you want to read.
